auth.authorize.caution.dm.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can read direct messages.

auth.authorize.caution.post.defaultMessage: Can post, edit and delete posts as you
auth.authorize.caution.post.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can post, edit or delete posts as the user.

auth.authorize.caution.profile.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can change the user's profile.

auth.authorize.group.defaultMessage: {risk, select, caution {Permissions that need your attention} write {Permissions that change things} other {Permissions that only read}}
auth.authorize.group.description: Heading on the consent page over the requested permissions of one weight: {risk} is caution (permissions that read direct messages, act as the user, or administer the server), write (permissions that change something), or read (permissions that only read).

auth.authorize.impersonation.defaultMessage: After you allow, the answer goes to {target}, which other apps on your device can also claim. It may be a different app from the one named above. Allow only if you started this from that app.
auth.authorize.impersonation.description: Warning on the consent page when the application is sent back to a loopback address or a custom URL scheme, which any app on the device can claim. {target} is that host or scheme.

auth.authorize.invalid.defaultMessage: This application's authorization request is invalid. Contact the application's developer.
auth.authorize.invalid.description: Error page (HTTP 400) when an application opened the authorization page with an unknown client or an unregistered redirect address.

auth.authorize.origin.dynamic.defaultMessage: An application that registered itself, with details it declared on its own
auth.authorize.origin.dynamic.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application that registered itself by dynamic client registration.

auth.authorize.origin.metadata_document.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application identified by a client ID URL. {host} is that URL's host name, which the server verified.

auth.authorize.origin.user.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application a user of this server registered. {owner} is that user's handle.

auth.authorize.origin.user_unknown.defaultMessage: An application registered by a user of this server
auth.authorize.origin.user_unknown.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application a user of this server registered when the user cannot be named.

auth.authorize.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Too many authorization requests were made for this application. Wait a little and try again.
auth.authorize.rate_limited.description: Error page (HTTP 429) when the authorization page could not fetch a client's metadata document because its fetch limits are used up.

auth.authorize.scope.admin.defaultMessage: Administer the instance, as far as your roles allow
auth.authorize.scope.admin.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.admin_read.defaultMessage: Read the instance's administration data, as far as your roles allow
auth.authorize.scope.admin_read.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin:read) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.admin_write.defaultMessage: Change the instance's administration data, as far as your roles allow
auth.authorize.scope.admin_write.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin:write) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.admin_permission.defaultMessage: Use the permission {permission} of your roles
auth.authorize.scope.admin_permission.description: Permission (an OAuth permission scope admin:<permission>, which only a token the user issues to themselves holds) listed where scopes are described. {permission} is the name of a permission of the user's roles, such as manage_invites.

auth.authorize.scope.follow.description: Permission (OAuth scope follow) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.push.description: Permission (OAuth scope push) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read.defaultMessage: Read your account, posts, and timelines
auth.authorize.scope.read.description: Permission (OAuth scope read) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts.defaultMessage: Read accounts, your profile, and your settings
auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Read the custom emoji you made and your requests for new ones
auth.authorize.scope.read_custom_emojis.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:custom_emojis) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_direct.defaultMessage: Read the direct messages you send and receive
auth.authorize.scope.read_direct.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:direct) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_filters.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:filters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_finance.defaultMessage: Read the totals of the instance's costs and income, as far as your roles allow
auth.authorize.scope.read_finance.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:finance) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.defaultMessage: Read your follows, follow requests, lists, and the accounts whose new posts notify you
auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes.defaultMessage: Read the accounts and domains you mute
auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_reports.defaultMessage: Read the reports you filed and whether they are resolved
auth.authorize.scope.read_reports.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:reports) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_supporters.defaultMessage: Read your subscription to the supporter plans
auth.authorize.scope.read_supporters.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:supporters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write.defaultMessage: Post and change things for you
auth.authorize.scope.write.description: Permission (OAuth scope write) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Request new custom emoji, and change and delete the ones you made
auth.authorize.scope.write_custom_emojis.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:custom_emojis) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites.defaultMessage: Add and remove favourites and emoji reactions
auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:favourites) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_filters.defaultMessage: Create, change, and delete your keyword filters
auth.authorize.scope.write_filters.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:filters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.defaultMessage: Follow and unfollow accounts, answer follow requests, change lists, and subscribe to the new posts of accounts
auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_media.defaultMessage: Upload images and edit their descriptions
auth.authorize.scope.write_media.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:media) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes.defaultMessage: Mute and unmute accounts, domains, and threads
auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.defaultMessage: Mark notifications as read and dismiss them
auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_reports.defaultMessage: Report accounts and posts to the moderators
auth.authorize.scope.write_reports.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:reports) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.defaultMessage: Post, edit, delete, boost, and pin posts, vote in polls, and set who may quote a post
auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_supporters.defaultMessage: Subscribe to the supporter plans, and change, cancel, and resume your subscription
auth.authorize.scope.write_supporters.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:supporters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.unverified.defaultMessage: This server has not verified this application. Its name is the application's own claim.
auth.authorize.unverified.description: Note on the authorization (consent) page of a third-party application: this server has not checked it; the name and logo are the application's own claim.

auth.authorize.website.description: The application's own home page on the consent page. {url} is the address the application declared.

auth.cross_origin.defaultMessage: The request was refused because it came from another site.
auth.cross_origin.description: Body of the page shown (HTTP 403) when a sign-in or sign-out form was submitted from another origin.

auth.document.privacy_title.description: Title and heading of the public page of the instance's privacy policy, and the text of links to it.

auth.document.terms_title.description: Title and heading of the public page of the instance's terms of service, and the text of links to it.

auth.forgot_password.invalid_email.description: Error of the form that asks for a password reset link when the email address field is empty or not an email address.

auth.forgot_password.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Too many requests from your network. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many requests from your network. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.forgot_password.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many requests for a password reset link from the same network. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.forgot_password.sent.defaultMessage: If an account uses {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way. {minutes, plural, one {The link works for # minute.} other {The link works for # minutes.}} If no email arrives, check the spam folder and the address.
auth.forgot_password.sent.description: Notice after a password reset link was asked for. It must read the same whether or not an account uses the address. {email} is the address the user entered; {minutes} how long the link works.

auth.form_expired.defaultMessage: This form has expired. Please try again.
auth.form_expired.description: Error on the sign-in screens (HTTP 403) when the form's anti-forgery token is missing or does not match, e.g. after cookies were cleared.

auth.human_check.failed.defaultMessage: Complete the check that you are not a bot, then try again.
auth.human_check.failed.description: Error (HTTP 422) on the sign-in and registration forms when the CAPTCHA check was missing, invalid, or expired.

auth.human_check.notice.defaultMessage: This page uses {service} to check that you are not a bot. {service} receives your IP address and information about your browser.
auth.human_check.notice.description: Notice next to the CAPTCHA widget on the sign-in and registration forms, followed by links to the service's privacy policy. {service} is the service's name, such as Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha.

auth.human_check.notice_recaptcha.defaultMessage: This site is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply. Google receives your IP address and information about your browser.
auth.human_check.notice_recaptcha.description: Notice next to the reCAPTCHA widget on the sign-in and registration forms, followed by links to Google's privacy policy and terms. Keep the names reCAPTCHA and Google: Google asks sites to show this statement.

auth.human_check.privacy_link.description: Link next to the CAPTCHA widget to the privacy policy of the company that runs the service. {owner} is a name such as Cloudflare, hCaptcha, or Google.

auth.human_check.terms_link.description: Link next to the CAPTCHA widget to the terms of the company that runs the service. {owner} is a name such as hCaptcha or Google.

auth.human_check.unavailable.defaultMessage: The check that you are not a bot is not available right now. Try again later.
auth.human_check.unavailable.description: Error (HTTP 503) on the registration form when the CAPTCHA service cannot be reached; the account is not created.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.invalid.defaultMessage: This link is not valid. It may have expired. You can stop the emails in your preferences.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.invalid.description: Error when an unsubscribe link is unknown or expired. Must not say which.

auth.reset_password.invalid.defaultMessage: This link is not valid. It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer password. Ask for a new link.
auth.reset_password.invalid.description: Error when a password reset link is unknown, expired, used, or older than the current password. Must not say which.

auth.sign_in.failed.defaultMessage: The email address or password is incorrect.
auth.sign_in.failed.description: Error after a failed sign-in. Must not say which of the two was wrong, so that it does not reveal whether an account exists.

auth.sign_in.missing.defaultMessage: Enter your email address and password.
auth.sign_in.missing.description: Error when the sign-in form was submitted with an empty field.

auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.defaultMessage: The passkey was not used. Try again, or sign in with your email address and password.
auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the browser's passkey prompt was dismissed or failed before anything was sent to the server.

auth.sign_in.passkey_expired.defaultMessage: The sign-in with a passkey took too long. Try again.
auth.sign_in.passkey_expired.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the passkey sign-in was answered after it expired (5 minutes) or was already used.

auth.sign_in.passkey_failed.defaultMessage: The passkey could not be verified. Try another passkey, or sign in with your email address and password.
auth.sign_in.passkey_failed.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the server could not verify the passkey (unknown or removed passkey, wrong signature) or its account cannot sign in.

auth.sign_in.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.sign_in.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many failed sign-ins from the same network or for the same email address. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_up.agreement.required.defaultMessage: Agree to the documents above to create an account.
auth.sign_up.agreement.required.description: Error under the agreement checkbox of the registration form when the form was sent without it.

auth.sign_up.email_invalid.defaultMessage: Enter an email address such as alice@example.com.
auth.sign_up.email_invalid.description: Error under the email address field when it is not a plain address.

auth.sign_up.email_taken.defaultMessage: This email address is already in use.
auth.sign_up.email_taken.description: Error under the email address field when another account uses the address.

auth.sign_up.error_summary.defaultMessage: The account was not created. Check the fields marked below.
auth.sign_up.error_summary.description: Alert at the top of the registration form when one or more fields need fixing; each field shows its own error.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint.defaultMessage: This server accepts new accounts by invitation only.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint.description: Hint under the invite code field, while the server accepts sign-ups by invitation only.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint_optional.defaultMessage: If someone invited you, enter the invite code. You can also sign up without one.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint_optional.description: Hint under the optional invite code field, while the server accepts sign-ups without an invite.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint_approval.defaultMessage: If someone invited you, enter the invite code: your account can be used at once, without waiting for review. You can also sign up without one.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint_approval.description: Hint under the optional invite code field, while new accounts wait for a moderator's review unless the applicant has an invite.

auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.defaultMessage: This invite code is not valid. It may have expired or been used up.
auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.description: Error under the invite code field when the code is unknown, expired, revoked, used up, or of a member who can no longer invite. Must not say which.

auth.sign_up.invite_required.description: Error under the invite code field when it is empty.

auth.sign_up.password_hint.description: Hint under the password field. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.password_invalid.description: Error under the password field when it is too short or too long. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Too many sign-up attempts from your network. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many sign-up attempts from your network. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.sign_up.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many sign-ups from the same network. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_up.reason_hint.defaultMessage: A moderator reviews new accounts before they can be used. Up to {max, number} characters.
auth.sign_up.reason_hint.description: Hint under the reason field. {max} is the longest allowed answer in characters.

auth.sign_up.reason_invalid.description: Error under the reason field when the answer is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length in characters.

auth.sign_up.refused.defaultMessage: This server cannot accept this sign-up.
auth.sign_up.refused.description: Error (HTTP 403) when the sign-up block list or the external review refuses the sign-up. It deliberately does not say why.

auth.sign_up.username_hint.defaultMessage: Up to {max, number} letters (a to z), digits, and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
auth.sign_up.username_hint.description: Hint under the username field. {max} is the longest allowed username in characters.

auth.sign_up.username_invalid.defaultMessage: Use 1 to {max, number} letters (a to z), digits, and underscores.
auth.sign_up.username_invalid.description: Error under the username field when it has characters other than a–z, digits, and underscores, or is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length.

auth.sign_up.username_taken.description: Error under the username field when another account has the username.

auth.status.action_deletes_in.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Your account will be deleted in # day} other {Your account will be deleted in # days}}
auth.status.action_deletes_in.description: When a ban deletes the user's account, in place of its end, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {days} is the time left, rounded up to whole days.

auth.status.appeal_state_label.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {Under review} upheld {Action kept} overturned {Action lifted} other {Appealed}}
auth.status.appeal_state_label.description: Badge with where the user's appeal of a moderation action stands, on the status page. {state} is pending, upheld (the action stays), or overturned (the action is lifted). The account status page of the app uses the same words.

auth.status.action_ends_in.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Ends in # day} other {Ends in # days}}
auth.status.action_ends_in.description: When a moderation action on the user's account ends, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {days} is the time left, rounded up to whole days.

auth.status.action_reason.description: The reason category of a moderation action, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {category} is the category's label (for example, Spam).

auth.status.action_until_lifted.defaultMessage: Lasts until a moderator lifts it
auth.status.action_until_lifted.description: Says that a moderation action on the user's account has no end date, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted.

auth.status.appeal_hint.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {You can appeal once, within # day. Up to {max, number} characters.} other {You can appeal once, within # days. Up to {max, number} characters.}}
auth.status.appeal_hint.description: Hint under the appeal field of a moderation action on the status page. {days} is the time left to appeal, rounded up to whole days; {max} is the longest allowed appeal in characters.

auth.status.appeal_not_sent.defaultMessage: The appeal was not sent. Check the field marked below.
auth.status.appeal_not_sent.description: Alert on the status page when the appeal form was sent with an empty or too long appeal; the field's own error follows below.

auth.status.appeal_sent.defaultMessage: Your appeal was sent. A moderator will review it.
auth.status.appeal_sent.description: Notice on the status page after the user appealed a moderation action on their account.

auth.status.appeal_state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {Your appeal is waiting for a moderator's review.} upheld {A moderator reviewed your appeal and kept the action.} overturned {A moderator reviewed your appeal and lifted the action.} other {You appealed this action.}}
auth.status.appeal_state.description: Where the user's appeal of a moderation action stands, on the status page. {state} is pending, upheld (the action stays), or overturned (the action is lifted).

auth.status.appeal_text_invalid.defaultMessage: Write your appeal in up to {max, number} characters.
auth.status.appeal_text_invalid.description: Error under the appeal field when it is empty or too long. {max} is the longest allowed appeal in characters.

auth.status.resend_failed.defaultMessage: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
auth.status.resend_failed.description: Error when the confirmation email could not be sent (for example, the mail server is down).

auth.status.resend_rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {You asked for the link too many times. Try again in # minute.} other {You asked for the link too many times. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.status.resend_rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after the user asked for the confirmation link too often. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.status.resent.defaultMessage: We sent a new link to {email}.
auth.status.resent.description: Notice after the confirmation link was sent again. {email} is the user's email address.

auth.status.verify_email.defaultMessage: Confirm your email address: open the link we sent to {email}.
auth.status.verify_email.description: Asks the user to open the confirmation link. {email} is their email address.

auth.two_factor.expired.defaultMessage: The sign-in took too long. Sign in again.
auth.two_factor.expired.description: Error on the sign-in form when the second step (the authentication code) was not completed within five minutes or was already used.

auth.two_factor.invalid.defaultMessage: The code is incorrect or was already used.
auth.two_factor.invalid.description: Error on the second step of signing in when the authentication code or recovery code is wrong or was used before.

auth.two_factor.missing.description: Error when the authentication code form was submitted empty.

auth.verify_email.invalid.defaultMessage: This link is not valid. It may have expired or been used already. Sign in to get a new one.
auth.verify_email.invalid.description: Error when a confirmation link is unknown, expired, or already used. Must not say which.

auth.authorize.scope.read_voice.defaultMessage: Read the voice chat rooms you can see
auth.authorize.scope.read_voice.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:voice) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_voice.defaultMessage: Open, join, and leave voice chat rooms, and host them
auth.authorize.scope.write_voice.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:voice) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_events.defaultMessage: Read the events you can see
auth.authorize.scope.read_events.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:events) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_events.defaultMessage: Create, change, and cancel events, answer them, and invite people to them
auth.authorize.scope.write_events.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:events) listed on the authorization page.

auth.external.github.button.description: Text of the button on the sign-in and registration pages that signs in with GitHub (a login provider of kind github that the server's administrators set up).

auth.external.discord.button.description: Text of the button on the sign-in and registration pages that signs in with Discord (a login provider of kind discord that the server's administrators set up).

auth.external.unavailable.defaultMessage: This way of signing in is not available.
auth.external.unavailable.description: Error page when the user opens the sign-in of an external login provider that does not exist or is turned off.

auth.external.failed.defaultMessage: The sign-in with the other service did not complete. Try again, or sign in another way.
auth.external.failed.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the external login provider did not complete the sign-in: the user cancelled it, or the service answered an error.

auth.external.expired.defaultMessage: The sign-in took too long or was already used. Start it again.
auth.external.expired.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the sign-in with an external login provider (or the account creation after it) expired or was used already.

auth.external.denied.defaultMessage: This server does not accept that account of the other service.
auth.external.denied.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the account at the external login provider does not meet the conditions that the administrators set (such as an organization).

auth.external.not_linked.defaultMessage: No account on this server is linked to that account of the other service. Sign in another way.
auth.external.not_linked.description: Alert on the sign-in page when no account is linked to the account at the external login provider and new accounts cannot be created with it.

auth.external.sign_up.email_verified.defaultMessage: {provider} confirmed this address. If you change it, we send a link to confirm the new one.
auth.external.sign_up.email_verified.description: Hint under the email address on the registration page of an account at an external login provider, when the provider confirmed the address. {provider} is the provider's name.

auth.external.other_user.defaultMessage: This link is for another account. Sign out, sign in with that account, and try again.
auth.external.other_user.description: Error page when the browser that opens the link or confirmation of an account at an external login provider is signed in as another user than the one who started it.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.done.defaultMessage: You no longer get emails of “{group}” notifications. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.done.description: Body of the page after an unsubscribe link stopped the emails of a kind of notification. {group} is the name of the kind, as the notification settings name it (such as Mentions).

auth.mail_unsubscribe.prompt.defaultMessage: Stop getting emails of “{group}” notifications? They still appear in the app.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.prompt.description: Text above the button that stops the emails of a kind of notification, on the page of their unsubscribe link. {group} is the name of the kind, as the notification settings name it (such as Mentions).

auth.reset_password.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: This server signs in only through the login providers, so this link cannot set a password now. If your account has none linked, ask the administrators.
auth.reset_password.login_providers_only.description: Error page of a password reset link while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same whether or not the link works.

auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: This server signs in only through the login providers. If your account has none linked, ask the administrators.
auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.description: Note on the sign-in page, and the refusal of a sign-in with a password or a passkey, while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same for every account.

auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: This server registers new users only through the login providers.
auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.description: Note on the registration page, and the refusal of a registration with a password, while the instance limits registration to login providers.

auth.status.deactivated_expired.defaultMessage: The date to reactivate this account has passed, and it is being deleted.
auth.status.deactivated_expired.description: Alert when a user tries to reactivate an account after the date of its deletion.

auth.status.deactivated_wrong_password.description: Alert when the password that confirms the deletion of a deactivated account is wrong.

auth.status.deactivated_sign_in_again.defaultMessage: To confirm the deletion, sign out and sign in again, then delete the account.
auth.status.deactivated_sign_in_again.description: Alert when a user without a password deletes a deactivated account in a session that started too long ago.
